requirements.text: Close the legacy 7-12 control-plane surface as revision-bound compatibility and inventory every active formal repository review entrypoint.

Produce a read-only finding-mode re-entry recommendation bound to current lineage, trigger, workload, promoted calibration, available baseline history, expected benefit, expected cost, confidence, and missingness.
Add reviewed, versioned cost-calibration promotion, conservative fallback, retained predecessor bindings, and rollback without self-promotion or history deletion.

When a declared high-risk Toolchain entrypoint has already selected complete semantic review, require thin Bootstrap delegation while preserving the existing lightweight route for ordinary low-risk AI-led single-maintainer work.
Relocate Phase-facing R4 behavior to 7-11 BH-SF2, BH-SF3, and BH-PILOT using existing PBR-026, PBR-044, PBR-024, and PBR-062 without copying Bootstrap authority.

Remain disjoint from current Bootstrap and Acceptance capabilities, the 7-31 Evidence Catalog, TC-D1 replay and seeds, TC-D2 quality baselines, BMAD/GDS installed files, and Phase product implementation.

acceptance.assertion: A machine-readable census classifies every active formal review entrypoint as repository-owner, thin-delegate, compatibility-only, or retired.
The old 7-12 CLI remains revision-bound, non-authoritative, and unable to acquire new durable behavior.
Recommendation replay fails closed on stale lineage, trigger, calibration, workload, or baseline bindings and preserves unknown data as missing.
Recommendation output carries authorizes empty and cannot replace explicit maintainer confirmation.
Only an explicit reviewed promotion command can publish a new committed calibration reference; generated candidates cannot self-promote.
Rollback selects a retained compatible predecessor or conservative fallback without deleting candidates, references, or run-bound history.

A declared high-risk Skill, route, lifecycle, acceptance, review-control, protected-path, or release-policy Toolchain caller that selects complete semantic review uses the repository Bootstrap owner; this rule does not automatically select review.
Ordinary low-risk work is not forced through complete three-layer finding mode and BMAD/GDS installed files remain unchanged.
7-11 plan validation binds the relocated adapter to existing PBRs and keeps review facts separate from Phase Permit, Mutation, Acceptance, browser, and release authority.

Terminal validation rejects any 7-12 slice that implements Catalog generation/publication, generic TC-D1 replay/seeds, TC-D2 quality labels, TC-D3 combined-review cohorts or activation, TC-D6 core Skill version governance, or Phase product behavior.
